text:
miriam: Pushed a rebase to main for feature/cache-prefetch and CI is red on linux-bazel. I resolved conflicts but the allocator test keeps failing in CI only. Can someone eyeball? :eyes:

miriam: failing snippet from the job log:
```
FAIL: //services/storage:shard_allocator_test (see /tmp/test-log)
AssertionError: expected 0 shards free, got 1
  at shard_allocator_test.go:142
```

aj: Hmm, that looks like TestShardAllocator nondeterministic failure. Could be a race or a test ordering assumption. Did you try a rerun?

ci-bot: Build 2874 for branch feature/cache-prefetch failed (linux-bazel). Rerun requested by @miriam. Rerun queued.

sam: If it only fails in CI, try running the test under the same hermetic env: `bazel test //services/storage:shard_allocator_test --test_output=errors --runs_per_test=10` to surface flakiness. Also check if the merge changed any default timeouts.

lee: Another quick check: the merge touched allocator.go — maybe a new background goroutine introduced a timing window. Can you paste the merge commit hash?

miriam: commit 3b9f2c4. I ran the test locally 20x — all green. CI fails consistently ~30% of runs.

aj: That smells like a race that manifests under CI load. Can you add `-race` or equivalent? Bazel's `--test_arg=-race` for Go tests should help.

miriam: scheduling a rerun with `--test_arg=-race` now. If it repros I'll attach the trace.

ci-bot: Rerun started: Build 2875 (linux-bazel) with additional test args.

ci-bot: Rerun complete: Build 2875 failed. Test `shard_allocator_test` failed again. Same stack trace.

aj: Oof. If race detector didn't fire, could be a logic bug (off-by-one in free counter) or a flakey mock. Try adding logging around the free count and dump state on assertion. 

sam: Another approach: bisect the merge range to find which commit introduced the failure. You can run `git bisect` locally on main..feature/cache-prefetch and run the test under the CI-like flags. I can help run the bisect if you want.

miriam: Will try adding extra logging first. If that doesn't show anything, I'll start a bisect. Can you stand by @sam @aj?

lee: I can help with bisect. Also consider reverting the merge commit temporarily if it's blocking other PRs — open a revert PR so we can get master stable while we debug.

miriam: Good idea. I'll open a quick revert PR and mark it WIP. If bisect finds the offending commit, we can reapply with a fix.

sam: Ping me when you start bisect; I have a CI slot and can run the bisect steps to reproduce in the same environment.

miriam: Thanks — starting the bisect now. Branch: feature/cache-prefetch (pushed). I'll post updates here. :thumbsup:

aj: Quick note: if you end up reverting, add a short blurb linking to this thread and the failing job number so we don't lose context.

miriam: Will do. Opening revert PR in 10m and will tag reviewers. Thanks everyone for the fast help.
